install: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; if (Test-Path package.json) { npm install }; if (Get-ChildItem -Recurse -Filter *.sln | Select-Object -First 1) { dotnet restore }; dotnet --info"

terminals.name: Dev Server
terminals.command: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "if (Test-Path package.json) { npm run dev }"
